quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. This takes only a few minutes and helps you stay safe.

questions.question: When riding behind a car, where should you position your motorcycle?

options.text: In any part of the lane.
Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror. Usually this means riding in the center of the lane. Drivers check rearview mirrors more than side mirrors, so this position helps them see you.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Always wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves when riding.

questions.question: How do you maintain control while turning your motorcycle?

options.text: Speed up before entering the turn.
Look through the turn to plan your path.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look through the turn to plan your path.
questions.explanation: Look through the turn by turning only your head. Slow down before the turn and lean your motorcycle in the right direction.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing including sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots that cover and support your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: When braking, which brake should you use?

options.text: One brake at a time, never both together.

questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time to stop. This is the most effective way to brake.

questions.question: What should you look for when choosing a helmet for the most protection?

options.text: One that has been in a crash.

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. Helmets should fit snugly all the way around.

questions.question: What is the best gear to wear when riding?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you. Use a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: If you have one drink per hour before riding, what will happen?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
You may still have side effects from drinking.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may still have side effects from drinking.
questions.explanation: The body removes about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your body. Your ability to ride safely can still be impaired.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection when riding.

questions.question: Before getting on a motorcycle, which of the following do you NOT need to check?
questions.explanation: Before getting on a motorcycle, check the tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, lights, and turn signals.

questions.question: When carrying a passenger, you should:

options.text: Set up and adjust your motorcycle for the passenger.
Ride the same way you would alone.
Tell the passenger what to do after you start riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Set up and adjust your motorcycle for the passenger.
questions.explanation: Your motorcycle must be designed and adjusted to carry a passenger safely. It needs a separate seat large enough for two people, footrests for the passenger, and may need adjustments to the headlight, tire pressure, and suspension for the extra weight.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT protective clothing?
questions.explanation: A leather jacket, long denim pants, and full-fingered gloves provide protection in a crash. Wear lace-up boots, high-top boots, or heavy shoes with ankle support instead of athletic shoes.

questions.question: What is the main active ingredient in marijuana?
questions.explanation: THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is the main active substance in marijuana.

questions.question: If a tire goes flat while you are riding, you should:

options.text: Slowly apply the brake on the tire that is not flat.
Go faster to leave the road quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowly apply the brake on the tire that is not flat.
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat while riding, release the throttle and go straight while you slow down. If you must brake, slowly apply the brake on the tire that is not flat.

questions.question: When riding, you should:

options.text: Always look ahead and watch for dangers.
Watch the controls and speedometer instead of the road.
Not worry about hazards because they are rare.
Look ahead but not for specific hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always look ahead and watch for dangers.
questions.explanation: Always look well ahead of your motorcycle to spot hazards early. This helps you react to problems before they happen.

questions.question: The best way to handle someone tailgating you is to:

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make rude gestures.
Speed up to get away from them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up only makes them tailgate faster, which increases danger.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Is too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket for protection when riding. In hot weather, a leather jacket can help prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool even in hot weather.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet has all of the following, except:

options.text: An outer shell that resists impact.
An inner liner that absorbs impact.
Bright colored paint on the outside.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright colored paint on the outside.
questions.explanation: A DOT-approved helmet must have an impact-resistant outer shell, an impact-absorbing inner liner, a comfort liner, and a chinstrap system.

questions.question: Which type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: When checking tire pressure, what should you do?

options.text: Look at the tire to see if it looks full.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare the tire height to another tire.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check tire pressure before every ride. A tire that is not full enough may still look okay, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: Which surface gives good traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces give poor traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings are all more dangerous than dry pavement.

questions.question: What type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that helps other drivers see you and your motorcycle. Bright, reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to notice you.

questions.question: How is the accelerator controlled on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is located on the right handgrip and is controlled with the right hand.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a tailgater?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make rude gestures.
Speed up to increase the distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If you can, change lanes and let the tailgater pass. Speeding up may cause the driver to tailgate you at a higher speed, making the situation more dangerous.
